claims.claim: Old rectangular black tempered glass center table
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a rectangular glass-top with black frame/edges and reflective glass consistent with a center table/glass panel.
Witness report does not show any marking/label or test evidence indicating tempered/safety glass.
Witness report provides no purchase date/receipt or age indicator.
Witness report mentions possible scuffs/dust and reflections, but does not confirm absence of stains/tears.
Witness report does not show foam or packaging materials.
Witness report cannot verify smoke exposure.

claims.claim: Legs for standing the tape are not included
claims.evidence: Witness report shows corner brackets/fasteners but does not clearly show whether legs/stand are included or missing.

risks.risk: Glass integrity issues (chips, cracks, edge damage) not clearly visible from the single angle; printed surface may be worn or scratched
risks.proof: One close-up video/clip of all four edges and all corners under bright light (tilt to catch reflections) plus a straight-on shot of the full glass surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a decorative glass top with unknown condition (assume possible minor damage) and treat as not guaranteed safe/undamaged.

risks.risk: Tempered/safety glass status unknown; if not tempered, it’s riskier and may be priced lower
risks.proof: Photo of any stamp/label on the glass (e.g., tempered/safety marking) or a clear shot of the underside where markings usually appear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified tempered glass (worst case: not confirmed safety glass).

risks.risk: Missing legs/stand or incomplete hardware; witness only saw corner brackets/fasteners, not the full assembly
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (legs/stand, screws, brackets, feet) and a clip showing the table assembled and stable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as glass top only / legs not included (worst case for usability).

risks.risk: Stability/wobble due to loose brackets or bent frame; witness notes possible scuffs/dust but not stability
risks.proof: Short clip showing the assembled unit on a flat surface with a gentle push test (no wobble) and a side view of the frame alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially unstable/needs re-tightening (worst case: assume wobble/looseness).

risks.risk: Size/fit uncertainty (dimensions and height) affects buyer suitability and resale value
risks.proof: Tape-measure photos showing length, width, and height (or thickness) from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic decorative glass center table with unknown dimensions (worst case: harder to match needs).

proof_requests: Provide exact dimensions (L/W/H) and thickness of the glass.
Show whether legs/stand are included: photos of legs/feet and all hardware, or confirm glass top only.
Upload close-ups of all four corners and all edges for chips/cracks (bright light, multiple angles).
Show any tempered/safety glass marking/stamp on the glass (underside/edge).
Provide a short clip of the assembled table on a flat surface showing stability (no wobble).
Show the full glass surface straight-on to assess scratches/etching and whether the printed design is worn.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a decorative rectangular black-framed glass top, but key pricing drivers are missing: whether legs/stand are included, glass condition at edges/corners, and tempered/safety confirmation. Without those proof shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
